spec.title: Antibody–antigen success as more seeds are sampled
spec.caption: Top-ranked DockQ > 0.23 success. Protenix-v1 on FoldBench Ab–Ag, bootstrapped from 100 seeds (Protenix-v1 report p. 6): 36.0 % at 1 seed, 42.9 % at 10, 47.7 % at 80. ESMFold2 (5 samples per seed): 49 % at 1 seed to 65 % at 1,024 (ESMFold2 p. 6; intermediate points not reported, line drawn straight in log seeds). Different benchmarks subsets; compare shapes, not heights.
